summary: A Depth subscribe at 20 or 50 levels is refused in the web adapter's own words, before the symbol is looked up, and nothing reaches mStock; Depth 5 is subscribed.

notes: mstock_adapter.py:239-242 answers INVALID_DEPTH with this message before the symbol lookup; the proxy puts the message alone in the failed item and answers status partial (server.py:1318-1340). The desktop refuses it at admission (feed::refusals).
